name: The St. Regis Deer Valley
insider_take: This ski-in, ski-out sanctuary sits at 7,200 feet elevation on one of America's most exclusive mountains, where no snowboarding is allowed and champagne sabering is a nightly ritual.
whats_special: The St. Regis Deer Valley is the only true ski-in, ski-out luxury hotel in Park City, featuring heated walkways and driveways to melt snow instantly. Deer Valley Resort consistently ranks #1 in North America for guest service and limits daily skier numbers to ensure pristine conditions and shorter lift lines.
pro_tip: Book your stay during the Sundance Film Festival in January – this hotel serves as unofficial headquarters for A-list celebrities, and you might spot major stars in the lobby or on the slopes.
dont_miss: The legendary St. Regis Butler Service and the evening champagne sabering ceremony at 6 PM. Also, experience Deer Valley's famous mountain cuisine – this is one of the few ski resorts where gourmet dining rivals major metropolitan cities, with multiple James Beard Award-winning chefs operating on-mountain restaurants.
pros: World-class ski-in/ski-out access to Deer Valley Resort
Signature St. Regis Butler Service and luxury amenities
Stunning mountain views and alpine luxury setting
Award-winning spa and fine dining experiences
cons: Seasonal availability with peak winter demand
